speaker: john_heminges
text: Two minutes. Eight shillings a share. I am not stretching a reckoning that has already come to its number.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Eight shillings. I stood the stair. I am not putting a second figure beside that one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight shillings, received. I am not making it a total, and I am not opening a coffer in a tiring-house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Received. Not a balance. The two minutes are done.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then let them be done. I am still in the house if you need the stair. You do not need it for eight shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We do not. God give you the two minutes back. There is another matter, and it is not this one.
